scenes.question: How are workflow models described with respect to versioning?
scenes.heading: Workflow models are versioned

scenes.question: Which runtime model does a running workflow instance use?
scenes.heading: A running instance uses the runtime model that existed when the instance started
scenes.body: The speech says that when a workflow instance runs, it uses the runtime model that was available when that instance started.

scenes.question: What action generates a runtime model in the workflow model editor?
scenes.heading: Triggering Sync generates the runtime model
scenes.body: Section 3 explicitly says that a runtime model is generated when you trigger Sync in the workflow model editor.

scenes.question: A developer edits a workflow model but does not trigger Sync. What is the result?
scenes.heading: Neither running instances nor new instances reflect the change until a new runtime model is synced
scenes.body: The speech says that if you edit a model but do not Sync, running instances and new instances do not reflect the change.

scenes.question: What happens if a runtime model is generated after a workflow instance has already started?
scenes.heading: That later runtime model is not applied to the instance that already started
scenes.body: Section 3 says edits made, or runtime models generated, after an instance has started are not applied to that instance.
